facts.fact_text: On 26 October 2008 a press conference was held in Gaziantep to protest about the conditions of detention and alleged ill-treatment of Abdullah Öcalan, the leader of the PKK (an illegal armed organisation).

On 26 October 2008 a demonstration was held in Gaziantep to protest about the conditions of detention and alleged ill-treatment of Abdullah Öcalan, the leader of the PKK (an illegal armed organisation).

The Adana public prosecutor noted in the bill of indictment that the applicant had participated in the gathering which had started in front of one of the offices of the Party for a Democratic Society (Demokratik Toplum Partisi – DTP) in Gaziantep.

The Adana public prosecutor noted in the bill of indictment that the applicant had covered his face during the gathering in front of one of the offices of the Party for a Democratic Society (Demokratik Toplum Partisi – DTP) in Gaziantep.

The Adana public prosecutor noted in the bill of indictment that the applicant had chanted slogans during the gathering in front of one of the offices of the Party for a Democratic Society (Demokratik Toplum Partisi – DTP) in Gaziantep.
The Adana Assize Court found it established that the applicant had participated in the demonstration of 26 October 2008.
The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 220 § 6 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 314 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
The applicant was charged with disseminating propaganda in favour of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).

On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court convicted the applicant of membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK, under Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code, on the basis of Article 220 § 6 and Article 314 § 3 of the same Code.
On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court sentenced the applicant to six years and three months' imprisonment for membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK.
On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court convicted the applicant of disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).

On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court sentenced the applicant to ten months' imprisonment for disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).
On 18 August 2009 the applicant started to serve his prison sentence.
The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 220 § 6 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 314 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
The applicant was charged with disseminating propaganda in favour of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).

A description of the relevant domestic law applicable at the material time, the domestic practice and the relevant international materials can be found in Işıkırık v. Turkey (no. 41226/09, §§ 30-37, 14 November 2017).
According to a police report dated 31 December 2008, on 26 October 2008 clashes occurred between demonstrators and the police in three neighbourhoods in Gaziantep.
As a result of the clashes on 26 October 2008 in Gaziantep, eleven police officers were injured.
As a result of the clashes on 26 October 2008 in Gaziantep, police vehicles were damaged by some demonstrators who threw stones.
As a result of the clashes on 26 October 2008 in Gaziantep, public buildings were damaged by some demonstrators who threw stones.
The Adana Assize Court noted that clashes had occurred between the police and the demonstrators on 26 October 2008, which had resulted in the wounding of some police officers.
The Adana Assize Court noted that clashes had occurred between the police and the demonstrators on 26 October 2008, which had resulted in damage to private and public vehicles.
The Adana Assize Court noted that there was no evidence showing that the applicant had been involved in acts of violence during the demonstration of 26 October 2008.
The Adana Assize Court acquitted the applicant of any charges relating to causing injury or damage in connection with the demonstration of 26 October 2008.

The Court of Cassation held on 30 December 2013 that there was no evidence in the case file in support of the allegation that the applicant had obstructed the security forces in the execution of their duties during the demonstration of 26 October 2008.
On 15 May 2014 the Gaziantep Criminal Court acquitted the applicant of the charges brought against him under sections 32 and 33 of the Meetings and Demonstration Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
